name: hit-connect
description: HIT Connect — Campus Information Portal Android App (Academic Prototype)

scripts.cap:add:android: npm run prepare-www && npx cap add android && npm run sync:android-icons
scripts.cap:sync: npm run prepare-www && npx cap sync android && npm run sync:android-icons
scripts.sync:android-icons: node -e "const fs=require('fs'), path=require('path'); const resDir='android/app/src/main/res'; if(!fs.existsSync(resDir)) process.exit(0); for(const d of fs.readdirSync(resDir)){   if(/^(mipmap-|drawable)/.test(d)){     const full=path.join(resDir,d);     if(fs.statSync(full).isDirectory()){       for(const f of fs.readdirSync(full)){         if(/^ic_launcher/.test(f)) fs.rmSync(path.join(full,f),{force:true});       }     }   } } fs.cpSync('assets/android_res', resDir, {recursive:true, force:true}); console.log('Synced official HIT launcher icons to', resDir);"
